msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.0: Rig your rod first — I have not stocked up yet...
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.1: I have watched this river forty years. The fish know me better than my grandson does.

msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.3: By day I am on the pier. When it gets dark, I go back inside.
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.4: Pick your chum spot carefully. Do not just scatter it at random.
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.5: Big fish will not take dead bait. You have to make it move.
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.6: Do not rush the reel. Let it tire itself out first.
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.7: Losing a fish is not always bad luck. Sometimes your line is just too thick.
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.8: That rod of yours — whose timber is it?
msg.anglertackle.fisherman.line.9: Easy, youngster. Things under the water do not hurry.

tooltip.anglertackle.guide_hint: Right-click to open - content is data-driven
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_deep.desc: A shallow-running reaction lure; sharp twitches trigger the strike instinct. For fish that chase actively in the upper layers.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_depthfinder.de: A bottom-hugging soft lure; its tail thumps to stir up deep-water schools.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_gilded.desc: Competition-grade work that takes gold and red quality alike. For chasing high-grade catches.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_glowspoon.desc: A glow-material spoon that softens the flash. Made for timid, wary fish.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_minnow.desc: Mimics a wounded minnow, rolling and diving in slow current. For tempting fish that chase mid-water.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_paddletail.des: The tail beats at high frequency for a strong disturbance, and it can be worked in deep water. For territorial and aggressive fish.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_rattle.desc: Rattles loudly to stir the fish around it and drive off the timid ones. For aggressive, territorial fish.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_soft.desc: A soft worm shape that stirs the water with its tail. For working snags slowly and teasing ambushers.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_spoon.desc: A spinning metal blade that fish take on sight. The beginner's lure - anything might bite it.
tooltip.anglertackle.lure_vibration.desc: A heavy vibrating bait: deep diving, hard shaking, made for big fish. Built for deep-water fish.
tooltip.anglertackle.mustard: Pungent condiment: cuts the smell of sashimi (optional, never required)
tooltip.anglertackle.palat.chronic.cigua: ⚠ Long-term: ciguatoxin builds up (%s meals → Nausea)
tooltip.anglertackle.palat.chronic.dioxi: ⚠ Long-term: dioxin builds up (%s meals → Poison)
tooltip.anglertackle.palat.chronic.mercu: ⚠ Long-term: mercury builds up (%s meals → Weakness)
tooltip.anglertackle.palat.raw_parasite: ⚠ Raw: may cause nausea (cooking makes it safe)
tooltip.anglertackle.pan_fried_fish: Cooked chunk + fish oil + salt: crisp outside, tender inside
tooltip.anglertackle.reel_resist_offset: Reel-speed resist offset +%.0f%% (the part of reel speed above 1.2 is resisted by fish tier; this reel's damping cancels this much)
tooltip.anglertackle.rod_cut_time: Bite wait -%s%% (float rod only, adds with bait)
tooltip.anglertackle.rod_type.float_rod: Float rod - strike when the float sinks
tooltip.anglertackle.rod_type.lure_rod: Lure rod - lure / depth / tension fight
tooltip.anglertackle.salt: Basic seasoning: salt-grilling, pan-frying and curing all use it
tooltip.anglertackle.sashimi: Raw chunk + soy sauce + fish knife: grants speed and water breathing
tooltip.anglertackle.smoked_fish: Smoked in a smoker: stacks to 64, good travel food
tooltip.anglertackle.soy_sauce: Fermented seasoning: braising, steaming and sashimi dip
tooltip.anglertackle.steamed_fish: Cooked chunk + water bucket + sugar cane + soy sauce: light and healthy (regeneration)
